summary: Iter 294 testing — director email digest (backend + real DB), single & bulk barcode print (code review + partial UI), mobile finance layout (fully verified end-to-end). Found and fixed a JSX compile error in FinancePage.jsx (missing in CoaPanel overflow wrapper) that was blocking the entire frontend. All 9 backend tests pass including the digest idempotency + scope guards.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing to close the `overflow-x-auto -mx-4 md:mx-0` wrapper before — broke ALL of frontend with a JSX SyntaxError overlay. FIXED by testing agent.

action_items: Seed at least 2 products with variants for a future iteration so that bulk-print end-to-end can be runtime-tested (currently /sales → Products tab shows 'No products added yet.' so bulk-print UI wiring was only source-verified, not clicked live).
Consider adding a rendered-count-only smoke test for _fire_overdue_task_director_digest in CI so scope regressions surface fast.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew past 1750 lines; _fire_overdue_task_director_digest and its siblings should live in a dedicated tasks_scheduler.py module.
Overflow-wrapper JSX pattern is duplicated 4× in FinancePage — a small <ScrollableTable> wrapper component would prevent the class of bug we hit at line 987.
Director digest uses date.today() (server local TZ) but the caller sits in the 08:00 UTC branch — inconsistent. Prefer datetime.now(timezone.utc).date().isoformat() so 'today' matches the scheduler.

success_rate.backend: 100% (9/9 tests, incl. digest create/idempotent/scope-guard + regression on review-queue, /reports/pdf ±fx, /hr/payslips/generate-payday, /bank/accounts, /finance/journal)
success_rate.frontend: Mobile finance layout verified end-to-end at 390×844 (all 5 tabs reachable, page scrollWidth=390=clientWidth). Bulk/single barcode print UI: source-verified only (no products seeded).

seed_data_creation: Backend tests seed TEST_ prefixed director + board + tasks in fixtures and clean them up on teardown. `db.task_director_digests` rows also cleaned up per director.
